newsitem.title: USA: Men file more large health claims than women - study.
newsitem.headline: Men file more large health claims than women - study.

text.p: The Society of Actuaries said on Monday more men than women made health insurance claims of $25,000 or higher, according to a study of catastrophic claims.
The society's report said men accounted for 52 percent of the claimants even though women spend more dollars on health care than men do until the age of 50.
Those who fell in the age range of 50 to 59 years old filed the greatest percentage of claims and the highest charges per claimant totalled $92,264 for newborns, followed by those over 75 years old.
The society said it used the records of about 171,000 claimants and about $10 billion in claims for the large claims report.
